name: Charred Peach & Burrata
description: Fire-kissed peach, torn burrata, basil oil, toasted hazelnut.
desc: Fire-kissed peach, torn burrata, basil oil, toasted hazelnut.
details: Peaches charred over embers and served at room temperature with burrata from Two Sisters Dairy, basil oil pressed in-house, and toasted hazelnuts.

name: Citrus Tuna Tartare
description: Hand-cut yellowfin, yuzu kosho, avocado, sesame tuile.
desc: Hand-cut yellowfin, yuzu kosho, avocado, sesame tuile.
details: Hand-cut yellowfin from the morning dayboats, dressed with yuzu kosho and citrus, layered over avocado with a crisp sesame tuile.

name: Wild Mushroom Toast
description: Woodland mushrooms on grilled sourdough, garlic butter, chives.
desc: Woodland mushrooms on grilled sourdough, garlic butter, chives.
details: Woodland mushrooms from Windrow Farm on grilled sourdough with garlic butter and chives. The vegan version swaps in olive oil confit — just ask.

name: Smoked Beet Carpaccio
description: Ember-smoked beets, horseradish cream, dill, rye crisp.
desc: Ember-smoked beets, horseradish cream, dill, rye crisp.
details: Beets smoked over embers, shaved thin, with horseradish cream, dill and a rye crisp. Fully plant-based on request.

name: Chapli Kebab Sliders
description: Charcoal-grilled chapli kebab, tomato relish, mint chutney, mini brioche.
desc: Charcoal-grilled chapli kebab, tomato relish, mint chutney, mini brioche.
details: Our Peshawar-inspired chapli kebab, pressed thin and finished over charcoal, tucked into mini brioche buns with a tomato relish and cooling mint chutney. Three per order — they rarely stay three per order.

name: Samosa Chaat Bites
description: Crisp samosa, chana chaat, tamarind drizzle, sev, coriander.
desc: Crisp samosa, chana chaat, tamarind drizzle, sev, coriander.
details: Bite-sized samosa broken over spiced chana chaat, dressed with tamarind and mint chutneys and finished with sev and fresh coriander. The starter our regulars order before they even open the card.

name: Tandoori Prawn Skewers
description: Charcoal-kissed prawns, ajwain marinade, charred lemon, green chutney.
desc: Charcoal-kissed prawns, ajwain marinade, charred lemon, green chutney.
details: Tiger prawns marinated in ajwain and Kashmiri chilli, kissed by charcoal and finished with charred lemon. Naturally gluten- and dairy-free — and gone fast on dayboat days.

name: Black Truffle Risotto
description: Carnaroli rice, porcini butter, aged parmesan, shaved black truffle.
desc: Carnaroli rice, porcini butter, aged parmesan, shaved black truffle.
details: Carnaroli rice stirred to order with porcini butter and aged parmesan, finished at the pass with shaved black truffle. A plant-based version is always available.

name: Cedar-Plank Salmon
description: Day-boat salmon over cedar embers, charred lemon, fennel salad.
desc: Day-boat salmon over cedar embers, charred lemon, fennel salad.
details: Day-boat salmon roasted on cedar planks over embers, with charred lemon and a fennel salad. Travels beautifully for delivery.

name: Honey-Lacquered Duck Breast
description: Alder honey glaze, charred parsnip, blackberry jus.
desc: Alder honey glaze, charred parsnip, blackberry jus.
details: Duck breast lacquered with Alder honey from Northgate Apiary, charred parsnip and a blackberry jus. Élise's favourite plate on the current card.

name: 12-Hour Braised Short Rib
description: Red wine braise, celeriac purée, gremolata.
desc: Red wine braise, celeriac purée, gremolata.
details: Short rib braised twelve hours in red wine — the recipe has not changed since 2019. Served over celeriac purée with a bright gremolata.

name: Saffron & Squash Linguine
description: Hand-cut linguine, roasted squash, saffron cream, crispy sage.
desc: Hand-cut linguine, roasted squash, saffron cream, crispy sage.
details: Hand-cut linguine with roasted squash and saffron cream, finished with crispy sage. Gluten-free pasta available for any pasta dish.

name: Butter Chicken Linguine
description: Tandoor-smoked chicken, makhani sauce, hand-cut linguine, kasuri methi.
desc: Tandoor-smoked chicken, makhani sauce, hand-cut linguine, kasuri methi.
details: East meets pasta course: tandoor-smoked chicken folded through a silky makhani sauce with hand-cut linguine and a finish of kasuri methi. The fusion plate that books out the pasta section on Fridays.

name: Wild Mushroom Tagliatelle
description: Windrow Farm mushrooms, garlic butter, parmesan, crispy sage.
desc: Windrow Farm mushrooms, garlic butter, parmesan, crispy sage.
details: Ribbon tagliatelle tossed with Windrow Farm woodland mushrooms, garlic butter and aged parmesan, crowned with crispy sage. Vegetarian comfort at fine-dining pace.

name: Tandoori Snapper Fillet
description: Whole-spice rub, charcoal grill, lemon raita, saffron pilaf.
desc: Whole-spice rub, charcoal grill, lemon raita, saffron pilaf.
details: Line-caught snapper under a whole-spice rub, grilled over charcoal and served with lemon raita and saffron pilaf. Cooked on its own section of the grill — allergy-friendly by design.

name: Char-Grilled Pomfret, Lemon Raita
description: Whole pomfret, ajwain marinade, charred lemon, kachumber salad.
desc: Whole pomfret, ajwain marinade, charred lemon, kachumber salad.
details: A whole pomfret scored, marinated in ajwain and lime, and char-grilled the Sindhi way. Served with kachumber and charred lemon — order it with the saffron pilaf.

name: Slow-Cooked Nihari, Burnt-Garlic Naan
description: Overnight beef shank stew, ginger julienne, burnt-garlic naan.
desc: Overnight beef shank stew, ginger julienne, burnt-garlic naan.
details: Our beef shank simmers overnight in whole spices, then arrives at the table with ginger julienne, green chilli and burnt-garlic naan for dunking. Sunday brunch's loudest order.

name: Mughlai Chicken Biryani
description: Dum-cooked basmati, saffron, burhani raita, crisp fried onion.
desc: Dum-cooked basmati, saffron, burhani raita, crisp fried onion.
details: Chicken and aged basmati sealed under dough and finished on dum, with saffron, fried onion and a burhani raita on the side. Gluten-free by nature — dum by tradition.

name: 24-Hour Mutton Raan
description: Slow-roasted leg of mutton, roasted-spice crust, mint chutney.
desc: Slow-roasted leg of mutton, roasted-spice crust, mint chutney.
details: A whole leg of mutton marinated for a day and slow-roasted until it yields to a spoon, under a roasted-spice crust with mint chutney and sliced onion. For two to share — or for one very good decision.

name: Chargrilled Malai Chicken
description: Cream-and-cardamom marinade, charcoal grill, truffle mash.
desc: Cream-and-cardamom marinade, charcoal grill, truffle mash.
details: Chicken rested overnight in a cream-and-cardamom marinade, chargrilled and plated over truffle mash with garlic butter. The quiet bestseller of the continental side.

name: Smoked Paneer Tikka, Saffron Pilaf
description: Charcoal-smoked paneer, pickled onion, saffron pilaf, mint chutney.
desc: Charcoal-smoked paneer, pickled onion, saffron pilaf, mint chutney.
details: House-set paneer smoked over charcoal, skewered with peppers and plated on saffron pilaf with pickled onion. Proof that the vegetarian main never plays second fiddle here.

name: Valrhona Chocolate Tart
description: 70% dark ganache, buckwheat shell, sea salt, crème fraîche.
desc: 70% dark ganache, buckwheat shell, sea salt, crème fraîche.
details: 70% Valrhona ganache in a buckwheat shell with sea salt and crème fraîche. Some weeks the pastry section swaps in a hazelnut shell.

name: Lavender Crème Brûlée
description: Tonka custard, lavender sugar, burnt-honey shortbread.
desc: Tonka custard, lavender sugar, burnt-honey shortbread.
details: Tonka custard under a lavender-sugar lid, cracked to order, with burnt-honey shortbread on the side.

name: Poached Pear & Almond
description: Orchard pears poached in spiced verjus, almond cream, caramel.
desc: Orchard pears poached in spiced verjus, almond cream, caramel.
details: Orchard pears poached in spiced verjus with almond cream and orchard caramel — naturally vegan and gluten-free.

name: Gulab Jamun Cheesecake
description: Baked cheesecake, gulab jamun, rose syrup, pistachio crumb.
desc: Baked cheesecake, gulab jamun, rose syrup, pistachio crumb.
details: New-York technique, Lahore heart: baked vanilla cheesecake layered with gulab jamun, rose syrup and a pistachio crumb. The dessert people photograph before they taste.

name: Kulfi Falooda Terrine
description: Pistachio kulfi, falooda noodles, basil seeds, rose jelly.
desc: Pistachio kulfi, falooda noodles, basil seeds, rose jelly.
details: Pistachio kulfi set as a terrine over falooda noodles, basil seeds and rose jelly. Deconstructed just enough to eat with a spoon, not a fight.

name: Chocolate Samosa, Salted Caramel Chai
description: Dark chocolate samosa, salted caramel, karak chai reduction.
desc: Dark chocolate samosa, salted caramel, karak chai reduction.
details: A crisp samosa wrapper around 70% dark chocolate and roasted nuts, served with salted caramel and a karak chai reduction. Dessert that argues back, pleasantly.

name: Smoked Pear Negroni
description: Pear-washed gin, campari, smoked vermouth, orange oil.
desc: Pear-washed gin, campari, smoked vermouth, orange oil.
details: Pear-washed gin, campari and vermouth smoked over the same pear wood as the kitchen fire. Bottled for travel on delivery orders.

name: Elderflower Spritz
description: Elderflower cordial, dry vermouth, soda, lemon twist.
desc: Elderflower cordial, dry vermouth, soda, lemon twist.
details: Elderflower cordial, dry vermouth and soda with a lemon twist. Zero-proof version available on request.

name: Kashmiri Chai, Pistachio Foam
description: Slow-whipped pink chai, pistachio foam, crushed almonds.
desc: Slow-whipped pink chai, pistachio foam, crushed almonds.
details: Slow-whipped the traditional way — hours of patience for that blush — under a pistachio foam with crushed almonds. Order it after the chocolate samosa and thank us later.

name: Lassi Trio Flight
description: Mango, salted and rose lassi, three mini glasses, one winner.
desc: Mango, salted and rose lassi, three mini glasses, one winner.
details: Three mini lassis — alphonso mango, pink-salt and rose — served as a flight. Everyone picks a winner; the house refuses to referee.

name: Jaljeera Spritz
description: Cumin, mint and tamarind cooler over ice, boondi float.
desc: Cumin, mint and tamarind cooler over ice, boondi float.
details: Our zero-proof nod to the spritz: cumin, mint and tamarind over tall ice with a boondi float. Sharper than it sounds, more refreshing than it has any right to be.

name: Doodh Patti, Tableside Brew
description: Pure-milk karak chai, brewed to order, served in brass.
desc: Pure-milk karak chai, brewed to order, served in brass.
details: Pure-milk chai brewed to order and poured tableside from brass. Two cups minimum — one is a warm-up, not a decision.
